title_zh: 刘洋：中国第一位女航天员
title_en: Famous Chinese People (11/20): Liu Yang, China's First Woman in Space
note_en: For people, formal Chinese often uses the measure word 名 (míng) instead of 个: 一名优秀的空军飞行员 "an outstanding air force pilot," 两名男航天员 "two male astronauts." English just says "a" or "two," but Chinese needs a measure word, and 名 sounds official, so it suits news reports and texts about jobs and ranks. Also note 第一位 and 第二位: 位 is the polite measure word for people, used here with ordinal numbers.
